Summarize multiply imputed LE8 scores

Source: R/methods-summary.R
summary.essential8_imputed_scores.Rd

Pools the scores from score_le8(impute = TRUE) or score_le8_imputed() across imputations with Rubin's rules. Means and category percentages get pooled confidence intervals and the fraction of missing information; standard deviations and quantiles are averaged across imputations. Counts are per participant (averaged across imputations), not per stacked row.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'essential8_imputed_scores'
summary(object, conf_level = 0.95, ...)

# S3 method for class 'summary.essential8_imputed_scores'
print(x, digits = 1, ...)

Arguments

object

An essential8_imputed_scores object from score_le8_imputed().

conf_level

Confidence level for the pooled intervals.

...

Not used.

x

A summary.essential8_imputed_scores object.

digits

Number of decimal places to print.

Value

summary() returns a summary.essential8_imputed_scores object, a list with n (participants), m (imputations), population, n_composite, n_complete, statistics (one row per measure with n, n_missing, pooled mean, std.error, conf.low, conf.high, df, and fmi, and averaged sd, min, q25, median, q75, and max), categories (pooled percentages with confidence intervals), conf_level, and settings. print() returns x invisibly.

See also

score_le8_imputed(), summary.essential8_scores()

Examples

adults <- read.csv(system.file(
  "extdata", "le8-adult-example.csv", package = "essential8"
))
adults <- adults[!startsWith(names(adults), "expected_")]
adults$non_hdl_cholesterol[c(2, 5)] <- NA

scores <- score_le8(
  adults,
  impute = le8_imputation_control(m = 5, seed = 1)
)
#> Warning: Number of logged events: 55
summary(scores)
#> LE8 scores: 10 participants (10 adult), pooled over 5 imputations
#> Diet method: mepa; min_components: 7
